BiblicalUsage: Meshobab is a Simeonite prince named in the list of the chiefs. 1 Chronicles 4:34 names Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah, among the princes of Simeon.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the list keeps princes we know nothing else about, because their tribe's story was worth telling in full.
